summary.en: A few days ago, Kogoro got hyped up when he saw Yoko Okino at the Spiral Mansion on TV, so he is taking Conan and Ran to the location today. The three are still debating about the tower of Babel when the curator Kaoru Neji arrives and explains to them about various spiral art and the owner of them, Kyu Tsurufuji. Later, the art magazine editor Kazumi Hayase arrives as he has an appointment with Neji and several members of Tsurufuji family: Kyu’s son Sensuke Tsurufuji, Sensuke’s younger sister Maimai Tsurufuji, and Sensuke’s wife Yoko Tsurufuji. While the Mouris continue their visit, Hayase tells them that the publication fee is 300.000 yenRoughly 1870 US Dollars as of June 13th, 2026, despite Kyu's contribution to conceptual art. Maimai accepts the deal, while both Sensuke and his wife refuse it, stating that they don’t have the money for that. Sensuke then leaves the room, with his sister trying to convince him to reconsider the offer. Yoko also leaves the meeting to return to her position. Hayase apologizes for messing up the atmosphere, to which Neji comforts him by saying it is not his fault and thanks him for coming to the meeting. Meanwhile, Kogoro and his family have just finished a room, and decide to go to another one. On their way outside of the room, they realize that there is no more room to visit that way, meaning they will have to go on another route. The three then hear a scream, which is followed by a gunshot.
